title: Migrations Best Practices
description: Manage database schema changes with EF Core migrations safely.

data.text: Manage database schema changes with EF Core migrations safely.
**Scenario:** Configure or implement the described functionality in an ASP.NET Core application.
Standard migration workflow for team development and production deployments.

data.title: Migration Workflow

data.text: Generate idempotent SQL scripts for production deployments.

data.title: Idempotent SQL Scripts
data.code:
# Generate SQL script for production
dotnet ef migrations script --from Initial --to AddProductCategory --idempotent --output deploy.sql

# deploy.sql - can be run multiple times safely
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM [__EFMigrationsHistory] WHERE [MigrationId] = '20240101_AddProductCategory')
BEGIN
    CREATE TABLE [Categories] (...);
    INSERT INTO [__EFMigrationsHistory] ([MigrationId], [ProductVersion])
    VALUES ('20240101_AddProductCategory', '8.0.0');
END
